item.title: Philippines Supreme Court Says Same-Sex Couples Can Co-Own Property
item.description: The Supreme Court of the Philippines has ruled that same-sex couples who live together can be recognised as co-owners of property under Article 148 of the Family Code, as long as there is proof they actually contributed. The decision was issued by the Court’s Second Division, with Associate Justice Jhosep Y. Lopez writing the ruling. […]
